title: Masked Woman and Red Figure
description: A woman in a gray dress and golden mesh mask stands in a broken purple doorway, her hand touching a large rectangular red painting. The painting depicts a tall red alien-like silhouette with white eyes against a red sky with comets, above a circular window showing small figures on a purple landscape. The surreal background is black with white geometric lines, floating objects, and a small astronaut figure.
prompt: A woman wearing a golden mesh mask and gray dress stands in a crumbling purple doorway, reaching out to touch a large vibrant red painting. The painting shows a tall glowing red alien silhouette with white eyes under a red sky with falling comets, and a circular viewport revealing tiny figures on a purple alien landscape. Surreal black background filled with white geometric lines, floating symbols, and a small astronaut climbing. Detailed, eerie atmosphere.
